listening.title: A job interview over a video call

lines.speaker: Hoa (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Good afternoon, Nam. Can you hear and see me clearly on your side?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes, very clearly. I am in a quiet space at home, so we will not be interrupted.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: Perfect. Let us start. Could you tell me about a project you are proud of?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Last year our team had to move an old report system to a new one.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: What was your own task in that project?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: I tested the data and trained six users. Sorry, was there a lag just now?

lines.speaker: Hoa (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: A small one, but I heard everything. Please continue with the result.

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: We finished one week early, and reporting time dropped from two days to two hours.

lines.speaker: Hoa (Hiring Manager)
lines.text: That is a strong result. Do you have anything you would like to show me?

lines.speaker: Nam (Candidate)
lines.text: Yes, may I share my screen for two minutes and walk you through the dashboard?
